facts.fact: Connected TV viewing peaks in summer for many key audiences, according to eMarketer (2024), as cited by the page.
facts.quote: Connected TV (CTV) viewing peaks in summer for many key audiences (eMarketer, 2024).

facts.fact: Streaming consumption among kids and teens jumps by 30-50% as schools let out, according to Nielsen (2024) as cited by the page.
facts.quote: Streaming consumption among kids and teens jumps by 30-50% as schools let out (Nielsen, 2024).

facts.fact: The page states that CTV CPMs drop 15-30% versus Q4 in many categories during summer, which is the page's own estimate without a cited source.
facts.quote: CTV CPMs drop 15-30% versus Q4 in many categories.

facts.fact: The page states that summer drives 20-40% higher restaurant spending versus baseline.
facts.quote: Summer drives 20-40% higher restaurant spending versus baseline.

facts.fact: The page states that the first heat wave of summer drives 3-5x baseline service calls for HVAC businesses.
facts.quote: First heat wave of summer drives 3-5x baseline service calls.

facts.fact: The page recommends that industries on its summer-driven list allocate at least 25-35% of their annual TV ad budget to summer.
facts.quote: If your industry is on this list, summer should be at least 25-35% of your annual TV ad budget.

facts.fact: The page states that most home sales close in the May through August period.
facts.quote: Most home sales close summer (May through August).

facts.fact: The page states that most weddings happen May through October.
facts.quote: Most weddings happen May through October.

facts.fact: The page states that pool installation, lawn care and related outdoor home service demand peaks May through July.
facts.quote: Demand peaks May through July.

facts.fact: The page recommends a seasonal campaign arc of planting seeds in May, peaking June-August, and converting through Labor Day weekend.
facts.quote: The brands that win plant the seeds in May, peak in June-August, and convert through Labor Day weekend.

facts.fact: Adwave says its platform can generate broadcast-quality 30-second TV spots from a website in about two minutes.
facts.quote: platforms like [Adwave](https://adwave.com/how-it-works) generate broadcast-quality 30-second spots from your website in about two minutes

facts.fact: The page recommends spending 15-20% of the total summer TV budget in May.
facts.quote: **Budget weighting:** 15-20% of total summer budget. Light spend with focus on awareness and category education.

facts.fact: The page recommends spending 25-30% of the summer TV budget in June.
facts.quote: **Budget weighting:** 25-30% of summer budget. Heavy direct-response and scaled awareness campaigns.

facts.fact: The page recommends spending 30-35% of the summer TV budget in July, the heaviest month of the season.
facts.quote: **Budget weighting:** 30-35% of summer budget. Heaviest spend of the season.

facts.fact: The page recommends spending 20-25% of the summer TV budget in August.
facts.quote: **Budget weighting:** 20-25% of summer budget. Final-push direct response.

facts.fact: The page recommends a frequency cap of 3-5 impressions per week for summer TV, which it calls the sweet spot.
facts.quote: 3-5 impressions per week is often the sweet spot.

facts.fact: The page recommends running a geo-holdout test in 8-10 markets with 3-5 demographically similar markets held out as control.
facts.quote: Run your TV campaign in 8-10 markets and hold out 3-5 demographically similar markets as control.

facts.fact: The page states that strong summer TV typically produces 10-30% new customer lift versus the same period in the prior year, a claim from the vendor's own resource page rather than independent data.
facts.unit: % new customer lift vs prior year
facts.quote: Strong summer TV typically produces 10-30% new customer lift versus same-period prior year.

facts.fact: The page estimates the cost of producing summer-specific creative with platforms like Adwave at $500-$5,000.
facts.quote: The cost of producing summer-specific creative ($500-$5,000 with platforms like Adwave; more with traditional production)

facts.fact: The page gives a restaurant summer CTV budget range of $1,500-$5,000 per month for May-August, using a 25-mile radius.
facts.quote: Local CTV in 25-mile radius. $1,500-$5,000/month May-August.

facts.fact: The page gives a hotel and tourism summer TV budget range of $3,000-$15,000 per month.
facts.quote: Source-market geo-targeting. $3,000-$15,000/month. Heavy May-July, taper August.

facts.fact: The page gives an HVAC and AC service summer TV budget range of $1,500-$8,000 per month.
facts.quote: Heat-wave reactive campaigns. $1,500-$8,000/month. Highest ROI of any seasonal industry on TV.

facts.fact: The page gives a pool and lawn services summer TV budget range of $1,000-$4,000 per month.
facts.quote: May-July heavy spend. $1,000-$4,000/month. Front-load May setup.

facts.fact: The page gives a real estate agent summer TV budget range of $1,000-$3,000 per month.
facts.quote: Family-targeting Q2 through Q3. $1,000-$3,000/month. Heavy June-August.

facts.fact: The page gives a sporting goods and outdoor summer TV budget range of $2,000-$10,000 per month.
facts.quote: May-July heavy spend. $2,000-$10,000/month. Family targeting.

facts.fact: The page gives an auto dealership summer TV budget range of $5,000-$25,000 per month.
facts.quote: Summer-sale-event creative. $5,000-$25,000/month. Heavy June-August.

facts.fact: The page gives a beverage and dining brand summer TV budget range of $5,000-$50,000 per month for established brands.
facts.quote: $5,000-$50,000/month for established brands.

facts.fact: The page says summer-driven industries should put 25-35% of annual TV budget between Memorial Day and Labor Day.
facts.quote: 25-35% of annual TV budget should hit between Memorial Day and Labor Day.

facts.fact: The page says neutral industries should put 15-20% of annual TV budget into summer.
facts.quote: For neutral industries, 15-20%.

facts.fact: The page says winter-driven industries need about 10% of annual TV budget to maintain awareness.
facts.quote: For winter-driven industries, 10% is enough to maintain awareness without wasting budget in slow seasons.

facts.fact: The page says summer TV often drives branded searches 24-72 hours after exposure.
facts.quote: Summer TV often drives meaningful searches for your brand 24-72 hours after exposure.

facts.fact: The page says summer mid-day viewing between 10am and 2pm jumps because kids are home and weather drives indoor viewing.
facts.quote: Summer mid-day viewing (10am-2pm) jumps because kids are home and weather drives indoor moments.

facts.fact: The page says households with kids ages 5-15 show meaningful summer programming consumption.
facts.quote: Households with kids ages 5-15 see meaningful summer programming consumption.

facts.fact: The page says beach resorts can target metro areas 200-500 miles inland.
facts.quote: Beach resorts can target metros 200-500 miles inland.

facts.fact: The page says travel and tourism campaigns should start as early as April for vacation planning windows.
facts.quote: Travel and tourism should start as early as April for vacation planning windows.

facts.fact: The page says service businesses with heat-driven demand such as HVAC, AC, and pool should start summer TV campaigns in mid-May.
facts.quote: Service businesses with heat-driven demand (HVAC, AC, pool) should start mid-May to capture early planners.

facts.fact: Adwave states that CTV CPMs in summer typically run 15-30% lower than Q4 across most categories.
facts.quote: CTV CPMs in summer typically run 15-30% lower than Q4 across most categories.

facts.fact: Adwave states that generic creative reused from fall/winter underperforms summer-native creative by 30-60% in CPMs and conversion rates.
facts.quote: Generic ads underperform summer-native ones by 30-60% in CPMs and conversion rates.

facts.fact: Adwave states that CTV starts at $30 a day through its platform.
facts.quote: CTV starts at $30 a day through platforms like Adwave

facts.fact: Adwave recommends 30-second spots as the standard for full storytelling and 15-second spots for direct-response and time-sensitive offers.
facts.quote: 30-second spots are the standard for full storytelling. 15-second spots work for direct-response and time-sensitive offers.

facts.fact: Adwave's 8-week summer TV ramp begins in early May and says to launch CTV campaigns 2-3 weeks before Memorial Day.
facts.quote: Launch CTV campaigns 2-3 weeks before Memorial Day. Light budget initially.

facts.fact: Adwave's summer plan says to update creative every 4-6 weeks during June through Labor Day.
facts.quote: Update creative every 4-6 weeks.

facts.fact: Adwave's summer ramp weights budget across the summer period using a 15-25-30-25 weighting.
facts.quote: Maintain pacing per the 15-25-30-25 weighting above.
